title: Design a Text Editor
description:
Design a text editor with a movable cursor backed by a doubly linked list. Implement the `TextEditor` class:
- `TextEditor()` initializes an empty document with the cursor at the beginning.
- `void addText(String text)` inserts `text` immediately before the cursor; the cursor remains right after the newly inserted characters.
- `int deleteText(int k)` deletes up to `k` characters immediately to the left of the cursor and returns the actual number of characters deleted.
- `String cursorLeft(int k)` moves the cursor left by up to `k` positions and returns the last `min(10, len)` characters to the left of the cursor (where `len` is the number of characters left of the cursor).
- `String cursorRight(int k)` moves the cursor right by up to `k` positions and returns the last `min(10, len)` characters to the left of the cursor.
constraints: text consists of lowercase English letters.
At most 2000 calls will be made to addText, deleteText, cursorLeft, and cursorRight.
hints: Represent the document as a doubly linked list of character nodes with sentinel `head` and `tail` nodes, keeping a `cursor` pointer on the character immediately left of the cursor (or `head` when at position 0).
Inserting a character splices a node right after `cursor` in O(1); deleting unlinks `cursor` and moves it to `cursor.prev` in O(1); reading the left preview walks back at most 10 links.

examples.explanation: Typing 'leetcode', deleting 4 leaves 'leet', typing 'practice' gives 'leetpractice', moving left 8 lands after 'leet', deleting 10 removes all 4 chars, moving right 6 lands after 'practi'.
Deleting or moving left on an empty editor returns 0 and empty string without error.
Inserting text in the middle of a word after moving the cursor left splices cleanly between adjacent nodes.
